Physiological functions regulated by GRP78

Physiological functions regulated by GRP78. (A) GRP78 is involved in regulating cellular signaling pathways and autophagy, maintaining UPR and ER homeostasis. (B) GRP78 is involved in regulating cellular metabolism. (C) GRP78 is involved in regulating cell apoptosis. (D) GRP78 participates in immune modulation
